title: Flaky test: a split part's round 2 step sometimes hangs off the wrong parent
lead: `TestLeadFixRoundHandsAFilesFindingsBackToTheOwningPart` passes on every run: the round 2 step of a handed-back part is always recorded under the lead's fix-round step, and the test reads it without depending on timing.
findings_note: 2026-11-17: `TestLeadFixRoundHandsAFilesFindingsBackToTheOwningPart` (`internal/engine/split_test.go:539`) failed once in a full `go test ./...` of the S407 worktree and once in 10 runs on main (a409ee76), with "the round 2 part step has parent "9", want the lead's fix step "10"" and parent "6" on another run; 20 further runs passed on each. Not caused by S407.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: A flaky test makes the project check red at random, which pauses relay runs and costs a fix round or an orchestrator rerun. The failure shows the part's round 2 step under an earlier step ("9" or "6") instead of the lead's fix step ("10"), so either the engine records the parent before the fix step exists (a real ordering bug) or the test picks the wrong "part P2" step when steps are written concurrently.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `go test ./internal/clitest -run TestSeqAnswersConcurrentCallsOnceEachInLogOrder` fails before the fix: concurrent calls to a fake get duplicate Seq replies and replies that do not match the call's place in the log.
- `go test ./internal/engine -run TestLeadFixRoundHandsAFilesFindingsBackToTheOwningPart -count=200` reproduces at least one failure before the fix, and passes after it.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Reproduce with `-count=200` (add `-race` too) and find which side is wrong: the engine's parent for the round 2 part step, or the test's choice of step (it keeps the last "part P2" step in slice order).
2. If the engine records the wrong parent, fix the ordering in `internal/engine/split.go` so the round 2 part step is written after, and under, the lead's fix-round step. If only the test is wrong, select the step by round, not by order.
3. Record the cause in the commit message and in a note on this slice.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- The test passes 200 runs in a row, with and without -race.
- If the cause was in the engine, a handed-back part's round 2 step is always the child of the lead's fix-round step.

Commands:
- `go test ./internal/engine -run TestLeadFixRoundHandsAFilesFindingsBackToTheOwningPart -count=200`
- `go test -race ./internal/engine -run TestLeadFixRoundHandsAFilesFindingsBackToTheOwningPart -count=50`
- `go vet ./...`
- `go test ./...`
- `gofmt -l .` must print nothing.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch.
